# Sharp fixers generated by nonnegative affine root groups (integer-valued data)

Lean module: `Langlands.Geometry.Building.IntegerValuationNonnegativeRootGenerators`.

Author: Worker 1407.

## Setting

`k` is any field (universe `u`), `v : Valuation k (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))`,
`G` an affine group scheme over `k`, and `B : IntegerValuationBuildingData v G`
the supplied KP apartment data: a connected reductive `G`, a maximal split torus
`i : S → G`, an apartment class `B.apartment` of valuations of the root datum of
`(G, S)` for the integer order of `v`, a centralizer datum and axiom V 6
(`isOmegaCompatible`). For `Ω : Set B.Apartment` the Library defines
`B.rootFixer a Ω = U_{a,Ω,0}` (KP Definition 7.4.1(1)),
`B.sharpFixer Ω = G(k)^♯_Ω = ⨆ a ∈ Φ, U_{a,Ω,0}` (KP Definition 7.4.1(2)), the
affine root groups `B.affineRootGroup a ψ = U_ψ` and the affine roots
`B.affineRoots = Ψ` (KP Definitions 6.3.1 and 6.3.4).

## The definition

`IntegerValuationBuildingData.nonnegativeAffineRootGroups B Ω` is the subgroup of
`G(k)`

```text
⨆ (a : relativeRoots B.i) (ψ : B.Apartment →ᵃ[ℝ] ℝ)
  (_ : ψ ∈ B.affineRoots) (_ : ψ.linear = rootForm B.i a)
  (_ : ∀ x ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ ψ x), B.affineRootGroup a ψ
```

generated by the groups `U_ψ` for `ψ ∈ Ψ` with `ψ(Ω) ≥ 0`. This is the
right-hand side of KP Lemma 7.4.4(3) (printed p. 256, PDF p. 287). It is the
right-hand side of the published target
`UnramifiedSharpFixerRootGenerationStatement` verbatim. It is the
integer-valuation analogue of the root-group part of
`ParahoricBuildingData.nonnegativeRootSubgroup`, without the factor `Z(F)^0`.

## Main results

* `mem_affineRootGroup_iff_reflectionFunctional` and
  `mem_affineRootGroupPlus_iff_reflectionFunctional`: the corrected AS 3,
  `U_ψ = {u ∈ U_a(k) ∖ {1} | ψ^u_a ≥ ψ} ∪ {1}` and
  `U_{ψ+} = {u ∈ U_a(k) ∖ {1} | ψ^u_a > ψ} ∪ {1}`, where
  `ψ^u_a = B.reflectionFunctional a u` has value `x_a(u)` at every `x`. These
  restate for `B` the local-field lemmas of the same names in
  `ParahoricBuildingAxioms`, with the same proofs.
* `affineRootGroup_le_rootFixer`: `U_ψ ⊆ U_{a,Ω,0}` when `ψ` has derivative `a`
  and `ψ ≥ 0` on `Ω`. Here `ψ` is any affine functional.
* `affineRootGroup_le_nonnegativeAffineRootGroups_of_not_double`: if `2b ∉ Φ`,
  `φ` has derivative `b` and `φ ≥ 0` on `Ω`, then
  `U_φ ⊆ B.nonnegativeAffineRootGroups Ω`.
* `affineRootGroup_le_nonnegativeAffineRootGroups_of_double`: the same when
  `2a ∈ Φ`, assuming `v` has a unit of order one and some `ψ₁ ∈ Ψ` has
  derivative `a`.
* `rootFixer_le_nonnegativeAffineRootGroups`: `U_{a,Ω,0}` lies in
  `B.nonnegativeAffineRootGroups Ω` under the two hypotheses `hunit` and `hlift`
  below.
* `sharpFixer_eq_iSup_affineRootGroup`: under the hypotheses

  ```text
  hunit : ∃ t : kˣ, IntegerValuation.order v t = 1
  hlift : ∀ α : relativeRoots B.i, 2 • (α : characterLattice B.S) ∈ relativeRoots B.i →
            ∃ ψ ∈ B.affineRoots, ψ.linear = rootForm B.i α
  ```

  for every `Ω : Set B.Apartment` (empty or not, bounded or not),
  `B.sharpFixer Ω` equals the supremum displayed above.
* `sharpFixer_eq_iSup_affineRootGroup_of_derivativeRoots`: the same equality
  with `hlift` replaced by
  `AffineRootSystem.derivativeRoots B.affineRoots = Set.range (rootForm B.i)`
  (the derivative root system of `Ψ` is `Φ`, KP Proposition 6.3.13, printed
  p. 221, PDF p. 252).
* `unramifiedSharpFixerRootGeneration_of_derivativeRoots`: the published
  proposition `UnramifiedSharpFixerRootGenerationStatement.{u}` follows from the
  hypothesis that, for every nonarchimedean local field `F` in universe `u`, every
  affine group scheme `H` over `K = inertiaFixedField F` and every
  `C : MaximalUnramified.BuildingData F H`, the derivative set of `C.affineRoots`
  is `Set.range (rootForm C.i)`. The unit of order one comes from
  `MaximalUnramified.exists_order_eq_one F`.

This module proves the target only conditionally. The hypothesis of the last
theorem is not proved here. Over the maximal unramified extension it is a
consequence of KP Proposition 6.3.13, whose proof uses Axiom V 7 (KP Definition
6.1.2, PDF p. 230) through Proposition 6.3.8 and Lemma 6.3.9 (PDF pp. 250–251).
The supplied data `IntegerValuationBuildingData` do not include V 7.

## Implemented proof

The proof is a port of the published local-field module
`ParahoricNonnegativeRootGenerators` to integer-valued data. The local-field
inputs are replaced by the Library's results for `IntegerValuationBuildingData`.

* `B.hasOppositeFactorPairs` (`IntegerRootReflections`) supplies the actual
  rank-one factorizations `m(u) = u′ u u″`.
* `B.isAffineRootSystemWithRankZero_affineRoots hunit`
  (`IntegerValuationAffineWeylProof`) supplies AR 1–AR 4 for `Ψ`.
* `B.finite_bounded_reflectionFunctionals_of_oppositePairs`
  (`IntegerAffineRootLocalFiniteness`) supplies the finiteness of the functionals
  `ψ^u_a` with bounded value at a point.
* `KPApartmentData.no_quadruple_root_of_oppositePairs` (`AffineRootDoubling`)
  shows `4a ∉ Φ`.

**Non-multipliable roots.** Let `2b ∉ Φ` and `u ∈ U_φ ∖ {1}`. Then
`ψ = ψ^u_b ≥ φ`, `u ∈ U_ψ ∖ U_{ψ+}`, and since `U_{2b} = {1}`
`KPApartmentData.mem_affineRoots_of_not_double_root` gives `ψ ∈ Ψ`. As
`ψ ≥ φ ≥ 0` on `Ω`, `U_ψ` is a generator, so `u` is in the subgroup.

**Multipliable roots.** Let `2a ∈ Φ`. By `hlift` some `ψ₁ ∈ Ψ` has derivative
`a`. `AffineRootSystem.IsAffineRootSystemWithRankZero.exists_le_apply` (published
in `ParahoricNonnegativeRootGenerators`) gives `ψ_top ∈ Ψ` with derivative `a`
and `ψ_top(x₀) ≥ φ(x₀)`, so `ψ_top ≥ φ` everywhere and `U_{ψ_top}` is a
generator. Suppose some `v ∈ U_φ` is not in the subgroup ("bad"). Every bad `v`
has `φ ≤ ψ^v_a < ψ_top`, otherwise `v ∈ U_{ψ_top}`. So the functionals of bad
elements form a finite set by local finiteness. Choose a bad `v` maximizing
`ψ^v_a(x₀)`. If `ψ^v_a ∈ Ψ`, `v` lies in the generator `U_{ψ^v_a}`, a
contradiction. Otherwise
`KPApartmentData.affineRootGroup_subset_mul_double_of_not_mem_affineRoots`
writes `v = v′ w` with `v′ ∈ U_{ψ^v_a+}` and `w ∈ U_{2a, 2ψ^v_a}`. The factor
`w` is in the subgroup by the non-multipliable case for `2a` (`4a ∉ Φ`). If
`v′ = 1`, then `v = w` is in the subgroup, a contradiction. Otherwise `v′` is
bad and `ψ^{v′}_a > ψ^v_a`, contradicting maximality.

**The equality.** `G(k)^♯_Ω ⊆ RHS` follows by `iSup_le` from the inclusion of
each `U_{a,Ω,0}`. For `u ∈ U_{a,Ω,0} ∖ {1}`, the functional `ψ^u_a` is
nonnegative on `Ω`, `u ∈ U_{ψ^u_a}`, and the two cases apply to `φ = ψ^u_a`.
`RHS ⊆ G(k)^♯_Ω` follows by `iSup_le` from `affineRootGroup_le_rootFixer` and
`KPApartmentData.rootFixer_le_sharpFixer`.

## Provenance

The definition and theorems are derived. They restate KP Lemma 7.4.4(3) and its
proof ingredients for the Library's integer-valued building data. The route
follows the published local-field proof `ParahoricNonnegativeRootGenerators`.
KP's own proof of Lemma 7.4.4(3) instead uses Corollary 6.3.10
(`Ψ′_a = Ψ_a ∪ ½Ψ_{2a}`). That corollary relies on V 7. The present proof uses
only the existence of one affine root with derivative `a` for each multipliable
`a` (hypothesis `hlift`), the actual rank-one factorizations, and the
integer-valued local finiteness. The module makes no claim about whether
`hlift` holds for given data.

Sources: Kaletha–Prasad, *Bruhat–Tits Theory: A New Approach* (2023): Definition
6.1.2 (V 7, PDF p. 230), Proposition 6.3.8, Lemma 6.3.9, Corollary 6.3.10
(PDF pp. 250–251), Proposition 6.3.13 (PDF p. 252), Definition 7.4.1 (PDF
p. 286) and Lemma 7.4.4(3) (PDF pp. 286–287).
